module: 'General Data' window of the live Vehicle Editor. Every frame, it sends the vehicle VM a command that returns (via obj:queueGameEngineLua) a table in vEditor.generalData: position, rotation, direction, roll/pitch/yaw, speed, accelerations (sensors.gx2/gy2/gz2), air/ground speed, temperature, pressure, air density and damage. It displays them with readable units.
notes: Displayed units: position m, speed m/s, acceleration m/s², temperature converted from K to °C (-273.15), pressure converted from Pa to kPa (*0.001), density kg/m³, damage in $.
The data arrives one frame late (asynchronous queueLuaCommand command).
The command is sent every frame the window is open (im.Begin true).

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: requests the data from the vehicle and draws the two-column table.
